title: unify-sdks-auth-retries-streaming-parity-and-version-bump-v1.66.1
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: there has been drift in how our Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs handle auth token refresh, retry backoff, and streaming chunk ergonomics. Customers upgrading between SDK patch/minor versions were seeing inconsistent retry semantics and slightly different streaming event shapes across languages. This PR unifies behavior and brings parity across SDKs, plus bumps published versions to v1.66.1.

What this PR does: consolidated retry policy and auth refresh logic into a shared behavior spec (implemented per-language), improved streaming API ergonomics (consistent event objects for 'data', 'done', 'error'), tightened type hints and TS generics, and added guardrails for token refresh races. Also includes packaging/version bump scripts and release notes.

Checklist:
- [x] Python: unify auth/token refresh + retries + streaming parser
- [x] TypeScript: retries ergonomic improvements + typed streaming client
- [x] Go: retry middleware + context-aware cancellation, streaming parity fixes
- [x] Tests: unit + integration streaming harness + e2e basic regen
- [x] CI: green for all SDK pipelines

Notes on risk: no public API-signature breaking changes (behavioral parity only). Token refresh behavior tightened (reduces duplicate refresh requests). Backoff defaults updated to remove a stale magic value (see release_notes).

review_conversation:
Lucas Rivera (reviewer): Please add a note about the change to the default backoff multiplier; I worry about long tails for bursty workloads.
Maya Chen (author): Good call — adjusted defaults from 2.0 to 1.8 and added a comment referencing ENG-8723; updated tests to assert new timings.
Priya Nair: In TS, the streamed 'data' event previously emitted raw strings in some cases; is the parser deterministic now?
Maya Chen: Yes, parser now normalizes to {type: 'data', payload: string | object} for all SDKs; added unit tests.
Olivier Dubois: Go change looks good but please ensure context cancellation closes underlying socket to avoid leak on client cancel.
Maya Chen: Added socket close on cancel and added integration test that asserts resource cleanup.
Maintainer (approved): Approving after tests green.
Author note: scoped the token single-flight implementation to per-client instance to avoid cross-tenant token reuse.

merge_outcome: Merged via squash by Olivia Park. Commit message: 'unify(sdk): auth/retries/streaming parity across SDKs; bump v1.66.1'
release_notes:
- SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go): unified auth token refresh and retry behavior (default backoff multiplier changed to 1.8)
- Streaming: consistent event shapes across SDKs (data/done/error) and improved parser robustness
- Bugfix: token-refresh race condition fixed to avoid duplicate refresh requests
- Version bumps: published SDKs at v1.66.1
- No breaking API signature changes; behavior tightening only
notes_for_backport: Backport not required for older minor versions; prioritize stable channel and release notes communication to SDK consumers.
